transactions_shape.name: transactions_shape
transactions_shape.value:
("type" = 'TRANSFER'
        AND "to_account_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "to_account_id" <> "account_id"
        AND "to_amount_minor" IS NOT NULL
        AND "to_currency" IS NOT NULL
        AND "category_id" IS NULL)
      OR ("type" IN ('INCOME', 'EXPENSE')
        AND "to_account_id" IS NULL
        AND "to_amount_minor" IS NULL
        AND "to_currency" IS NULL
        AND "category_id" IS NOT NULL)

income_deductions_shape.name: income_deductions_shape
income_deductions_shape.value:
("kind" = 'PERCENT' AND "rate_bp" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND "amount_minor" IS NULL
          AND "currency" IS NULL AND "base" IN ('GROSS', 'REMAINDER'))
        OR ("kind" = 'FIXED' AND "amount_minor" >= 0 AND "rate_bp" IS NULL AND "base" = 'GROSS'
          AND ("currency" IS NULL OR "currency" IN ('PLN', 'EUR', 'USD', 'CAD')))

income_deductions_start.name: income_deductions_start
income_deductions_start.value: "start_month" IS NULL OR ("start_month" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[01][0-9]' AND substr("start_month", 6, 2) BETWEEN '01' AND '12')

income_deductions_end.name: income_deductions_end
income_deductions_end.value: "end_month" IS NULL OR ("end_month" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[01][0-9]' AND substr("end_month", 6, 2) BETWEEN '01' AND '12')

income_deductions_period.name: income_deductions_period
income_deductions_period.value: "start_month" IS NULL OR "end_month" IS NULL OR "end_month" >= "start_month"

income_sources_end.name: income_sources_end
income_sources_end.value: "end_month" IS NULL OR ("end_month" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[01][0-9]' AND substr("end_month", 6, 2) BETWEEN '01' AND '12')

purchases_planned_month.name: purchases_planned_month
purchases_planned_month.value: "planned_month" IS NULL OR ("planned_month" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[01][0-9]' AND substr("planned_month", 6, 2) BETWEEN '01' AND '12')

purchases_status_shape.name: purchases_status_shape
purchases_status_shape.value:
("status" = 'PURCHASED' AND "actual_amount_minor" >= 0
          AND ("purchased_on" IS NOT NULL OR "planned_month" IS NOT NULL))
        OR ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'CANCELLED') AND "purchased_on" IS NULL AND "actual_amount_minor" IS NULL)

recurring_expenses_end.name: recurring_expenses_end
recurring_expenses_end.value: "end_month" IS NULL OR ("end_month" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[01][0-9]' AND substr("end_month", 6, 2) BETWEEN '01' AND '12')

fund_rules_shape.name: fund_rules_shape
fund_rules_shape.value:
("mode" = 'FIXED' AND "amount_minor" >= 0)
        OR ("mode" = 'PERCENT' AND "percent_bp" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND "percent_base" IN ('NET_INCOME', 'OWNER_INCOME', 'FREE'))
        OR "mode" = 'REMAINDER'

savings_movements_repay.name: savings_movements_repay
savings_movements_repay.value: "repay_month" IS NULL OR ("type" = 'WITHDRAWAL' AND "repay_month" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[01][0-9]' AND substr("repay_month", 6, 2) BETWEEN '01' AND '12')
